beats.fact: A delayed coach brought you together at the Crooked Mile Inn. The inn floor unrolls toward the marsh. Mara Flint braces the stamped hearthstone with a bending poker while a Guild surveyor watches. The Brass surveyor duck demands a witness. The narrow dry route between the toll gates leads uphill.

place.name: Crooked Mile Inn Common Room
place.atmosphere: Rain rattles the slate roof; hearthlight glitters on wet floorboards and brass.
place.hazard: The common-room floor is unrolling toward deep marsh water, carrying tables and a mule; the poker bracing the stamped hearthstone is bending, while toll gates outside narrow the route to dry ground.
place.riskReason: Delay risks the sliding tables and their occupants reaching the marsh water, while the dry route outside is narrowing.

journal.name: The passengers’ shared circumstance
journal.fact: The delayed baronial coach brought its passengers together at the Crooked Mile Inn for supper; their prior acquaintance is not established.

journal.name: Crooked Mile Inn Common Room
journal.fact: The floor is unrolling toward the marsh with two occupied tables and a mule aboard; Mara Flint’s bending poker braces a hearthstone stamped PUBLIC HIGHWAY. The brass surveyor duck lies beneath a bench demanding a witness. Outside, toll gates are narrowing the dry route.

summary: The sliding floor threatens the Crooked Mile Inn.

features.name: Stamped Hearthstone
features.description: The hearthstone bears the fresh brass stamp PUBLIC HIGHWAY; a bending poker braces it while the floor unrolls toward the marsh.

features.name: Rival Survey Crews’ Toll Gates
features.description: Outside, rival crews stake claims and their gates narrow the route to dry ground.

features.name: Lantern-Marked Marsh Path
features.description: A visible route beyond the toll gates.

mysteries.name: The Duck’s Deed
mysteries.description: The duck’s belly is said to contain a deed that could bear on control of the causeways; the deed’s authenticity and what it might establish remain unknown.
